name: Transfixing Area
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, inquisitor 6, mesmerist 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, summoner/unchained summoner 6, witch 6
Area 10 ft. radius emanation

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as transfix person except it affects all humanoids within the spell’s area. Additionally, any humanoid that enters the area must make a successful Will save or be affected by the spell with the same conditions.
